Hero.description: B&B Unikoop supplies industrial bearings, power transmission equipment and maintenance solutions across North Macedonia. As an official SKF distributor, we deliver 100% genuine products.

about.p1: B&B Unikoop is the official SKF distributor for North Macedonia. For 35 years we have supplied industries with bearings, housings, seals, belts, chains and lubrication systems.
about.p2: Our mission is to reduce downtime and ensure continuity in our clients' operations – with genuine products and expert support, 24/7.

sections.p: B&B Unikoop ("we") is the controller of personal data collected through this website. Contact: <link>/contact</link>.
When you write to us via the contact form: name, email, phone (optional) and the message content. We do not request or collect sensitive data.
We use the data only to respond to your request and prepare a quote, based on your consent and our legitimate interest in business communication.
We keep the data only as long as needed for the communication and legal obligations, after which it is deleted.
We do not sell your data. It may be processed by service providers (hosting, email delivery) only on our instructions.
This website does not use tracking or advertising cookies. Technically necessary cookies may be used.
You have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict, port and object, as well as the right to lodge a complaint with the Personal Data Protection Agency. Send requests via the contact page.
By using this website you accept these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use it.

The catalog is for informational purposes. Dimensions, designations and descriptions are provided in good faith but may contain errors. Verify the details with us before ordering. Information on the site does not constitute a binding offer.
Prices and stock are not published on the site and are agreed individually through a quote.
The site's content is owned by B&B Unikoop or its rights holders. SKF and other brands belong to their respective owners. Copying without our consent is not permitted.
We accept no liability for damage arising from use of the information on the site, to the extent permitted by law.
The terms may change; the version published on the site applies. The law of the Republic of North Macedonia is applicable.
